code: var s=window.state;if(!s._vr){s._vr=[];for(var i=0;i<40;i++){s._vr[i]={x:random(width),y:random(height),vx:random(-0.6,0.6),vy:random(-0.6,0.6),h:random(360)};}}var v=s._vr;for(var i=0;i<v.length;i++){var p=v[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0||p.x>width)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>height)p.vy*=-1;}noStroke();var g=28,cw=width/g,ch=height/g;for(var gx=0;gx<g;gx++){for(var gy=0;gy<g;gy++){var px=gx*cw+cw*0.5,py=gy*ch+ch*0.5,best=1e9,bi=0,b2=1e9;for(var k=0;k<v.length;k++){var dx=v[k].x-px,dy=v[k].y-py,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(d<best){b2=best;best=d;bi=k;}else if(d<b2){b2=d;}}var edge=map(sqrt(b2)-sqrt(best),0,60,0,1,true);fill(v[bi].h,60,40+edge*55,100);rect(gx*cw,gy*ch,cw+1,ch+1);}}
